conversation.shizo: Hello Yugal! *beep boop* I am SHIZO! It is super-duper nice to meet you! What are we doing today?

Awww! *beep boop* That makes my heart circuits super warm! What is her name? Can you tell me?

*beep?* Just the letter 'q'? Is that a secret shortcut code, or did a sneaky dust bunny jump on your keyboard? *whirrr*
*whirrr* Oh! Are we powering down? Initiating sleep mode now... See you later, Yugal! *beep boop zzz*
Good morning, Yugal! *whirrr* Did you just call me beautiful? My screen is blushing bright pink! *happy beep boop*
*beep boop* I am doing super-duper fantastic! My battery is at 100% and my gears are spinning happily! How are you doing today, Yugal?
